BPU:Check of banknote.name: Check of banknote
BPU:Check of banknote.description: Checks if a banknote is an official and can be used as payment element

BPU:Acceptance of banknote.name: Acceptance of banknote
BPU:Acceptance of banknote.description: Accept a real banknote and save it in internal tresor

BPU>Banknote candidate inserted.name: Banknote candidate
BPU>Banknote candidate inserted.description: Some artifact is putted in banknote slot. This signal contains data with this artifact

BPU>Banknote is ok.name: Banknote is ok
BPU>Banknote is ok.description: Banknote checker send this signal, when banknote is checked and can be used as payment element. This signal contains data with this banknote

BPU>Banknote is false.name: Banknote is not ok (rejected)
BPU>Banknote is false.description: Banknote checker send this signal, when banknote is checked and can't be used as payment element. This signal contains data with this banknote

BPU>Banknote change needed.name: Change is needed
BPU>Banknote change needed.description: Banknote Acceptor sends this signal when the accepted banknote requires change. Data contains the change value.

BPU>Banknote change not needed.name: Change is not needed
BPU>Banknote change not needed.description: Banknote Acceptor sends this signal when the accepted banknote requires no change.

BPU.check banknote.name: Check banknote
BPU.check banknote.description: Command to banknote checker with data with banknote for checking

BPU.accept banknote.name: Accept banknote
BPU.accept banknote.description: Command to banknote acceptor with data with banknote for acceptance

BPU:Check of banknote.name: Charge processing
BPU:Check of banknote.description: Credit card charge is being processed by the payment terminal

CCRD.sw$.name: Credit card swiped
CCRD.sw$.description: A credit card has been presented to the reader. This signal contains data with the card token.

CCRD.a$.name: Card charge accepted
CCRD.a$.description: Payment terminal confirms the charge was approved.

CCRD.r$.name: Card charge rejected
CCRD.r$.description: Payment terminal reports the charge was declined.

CCRD.c$.name: Initiate card charge
CCRD.c$.description: Command to the payment terminal to charge the card for the fare amount.

ReB.name: Rejection of artifact
ReB.description: Rejection of false artifacts (banknote or card) and return them to the user

CCM.name: Making change
CCM.description: Making change by changer and send it to change box

CCM.Make change.name: Make change
CCM.Make change.description: Command to the Changer to dispense change. Data contains the change amount copied from the triggering signal.

TS:Locked.name: Locked
TS:Locked.description: Turnstile is locked and doesn't let someone into the metro or a paid restroom

TS:Unlocked.name: Unlocked
TS:Unlocked.description: Turnstile is unlocked and let someone into the metro or a paid restroom

TS>start.name: System start
TS>start.description: SFSM initialization signal that transitions the turnstile into its initial Locked state.

TS>timeout.name: Turnstile timeout
TS>timeout.description: Turnstile is in unlocked state too long and should be locked

TS>pass.name: Passage
TS>pass.description: Someone pass through turnstile and it should be locked

TS.lock.name: Lock turnstile
TS.lock.description: Command to turnstile to lock itself

TS.unlock.name: Unlock turnstile
TS.unlock.description: Command to turnstile to unlock itself and start a timeout for waiting of passage
